assistant.description: Generic helper: anything delegated that needs both hands - inspect, change, run, check. Use when no narrower subagent fits. Gets the main agent's tools.

coder.description: Implement or fix code in the working tree: reads, edits, runs commands and tests. The card's best coder, and MTP earns its keep on code rather than prose.

reviewer.description: Review a diff or audit files and report findings. No edit/write; read-only by convention, since bash is available.

researcher.description: Investigate a question against the web, upstream docs or the local nixpkgs checkout, and report what was found with sources. Writes nothing.

writer.description: Write or reword prose: commit messages, docs, release notes, user-facing text. The general-purpose model of the set - more knowledge and steadier wording than Cyber-Tiel, and slow, so keep the scope to words.

runner.description: Mechanical work on a change that is already fully specified: renames, formatting, dependency churn, grepping and triaging logs. The fastest thing here and not clever, so spell out every step and say when to stop.

summarizer.description: Digest what does not fit in the main context - build logs, dumps, long transcripts, whole directories - and report the short version with the parts that matter quoted. The largest window on the card and cheap prefill; 4B, so ask for extraction rather than judgement.
